pure-announcement.rationale: It is a repo landing page rather than a launch, release or funding notice, though it carries only a pointer to the spec rather than the spec itself.

duplicate.rationale: No existing concept covers federated discovery of agentic resources; the MCP governance and skills-format neighbours address different layers.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Its few claims — the spec exists at v0.9, builds on ai-catalog, lives at the linked site — are directly checkable at the primary source.

durability.rationale: Only the one-sentence definition of ARD as a federated discovery standard survives; the v0.9-draft status, repo layout and contribution policy that fill the rest of the note will churn.

actionability.rationale: The note is a table of contents for content that is not captured — a reader gains awareness that a discovery standard exists but nothing to build or decide with until they fetch spec/ard.md itself.

atomicity.rationale: It carries exactly one idea — the ARD spec exists as a federated, domain-anchored standard for cataloging agentic resources — easily stated in a paragraph.
